ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
ISCHANGED(Agent_Status__c),
OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Agent_Status__c),"In Active"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Agent_Status__c),"Suspended"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Agent_Status__c),"Rejected"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Agent_Status__c),"Blocked") ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Agent_Status__c,"Active"), ISPICKVAL(Agent_Status__c,"Pending Verification") )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Agent Status cannot be changed to Active or Pending Verification when the current status is In Active, Suspended, Rejected, or Blocked.
